method: manual source review via the live EURES public JSON API (https://europa.eu/eures/api/jv-searchengine/public/jv/id/{source_id}): each posting fetched live from a europa.eu origin page, stored title compared against the live title, and the live body read for role confirmation before translation. Not model output. 15 of 18 candidates in this window returned HTTP 200 with exact title matches and were filled. Three postings returned HTTP 404 (dead postings) and were skipped without a fill: 1de272bb52b62575 (FI, Varastotyontekija Lahti); 1f81a0b1afb6aee2 (SK, Pracovnici v sklade); 20317433fbf78fc2 (FR, MAGASINIER PREPARATEUR MATIERES INDUSTRIE CHIMIQUE) - the dead-link sweep handles them. The five previously held postings (00cfb0e9af186fce, 0c10c84afe31213a, 0dad6f50ad84127b, 108f2edcfb6b67d8, 112d65cfb3e268bf) were skipped and remain held. No candidate in this window carried the legacy partial-AR marker, so no overwrite:true fills were needed.
